Package com.kristensoft.kdc

Class WebSocketEndpoint

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.eclipse.jetty.websocket.api.WebSocketAdapter
      • com.kristensoft.kdc.WebSocketEndpoint
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    org.eclipse.jetty.websocket.api.WebSocketConnectionListener, org.eclipse.jetty.websocket.api.WebSocketListener
    public class WebSocketEndpoint
extends org.eclipse.jetty.websocket.api.WebSocketAdapter
    Provides the WebSocket endpoint used by a WebSocketServer to receive client connections and messages.

    Binary WebSocket messages are deserialized into Agent instances and queued for processing. Text messages are logged but are not processed as KDC agents.

    Author:
    Charles B. Kozoyed
    See Also:
    WebSocketServer, WebSocketAgentQueue

      • onWebSocketBinary

        public void onWebSocketBinary​(byte[] payload,
                              int offset,
                              int length)
        Called when a binary message is received over the WebSocket connection.

        The received message is deserialized into an Agent, its receive latency metrics are updated, and the agent is added to the WebSocket agent queue for processing.

        Specified by:
        onWebSocketBinary in interface org.eclipse.jetty.websocket.api.WebSocketListener
        Overrides:
        onWebSocketBinary in class org.eclipse.jetty.websocket.api.WebSocketAdapter
        Parameters:
        payload - the byte array containing the received WebSocket message
        offset - the offset of the message data within payload
        length - the length of the message data
